procurement.title: Real retail shop floor, fixed overhead camera
procurement.needs: Detector accuracy on real subjects at real scale; reflections from glass and polished floor.
procurement.blocks: Any claim about retail detection accuracy, and the loitering false-positive rate.
procurement.consent: Signed footage-use agreement from the store; faces blurred or a private fixture repo.

procurement.title: Shopping-centre concourse, wide angle, heavy footfall
procurement.needs: Genuine crowd density and mutual occlusion — the thing the `crowd` fixture only gestures at.
procurement.blocks: Crowd counting accuracy; the NMS suppression question the crowd fixture raises.

procurement.title: Warehouse aisle with forklift and pedestrian traffic
procurement.blocks: Any safety claim about pedestrian–vehicle separation.
procurement.consent: Site operator agreement; union/works-council notice where required.

procurement.title: Hospital corridor, mixed staff and public
procurement.needs: Uniform-heavy scenes, trolleys, and long thin geometry with strong perspective.
procurement.consent: ⛔ Highest bar in this table — patient privacy. Likely requires a synthetic re-enactment on a real ward instead of live footage.

procurement.title: Production line, fixed camera, machinery in motion
procurement.needs: Persistent non-human motion — the single largest false-positive source in industrial installs.
procurement.blocks: Industrial deployment claims; the moving-machinery false-positive rate.

procurement.title: Outdoor car park, day→dusk transition
procurement.needs: Real low-light transition, headlights, and weather — the honest version of `night-footage` and `rain`.
procurement.blocks: Outdoor/overnight claims; everything the `night-footage` and `rain` fixtures approximate.
procurement.consent: Site operator agreement; ANPR rules may apply in some jurisdictions.
